resources.string: Provides PIN-as-biometric fallback for apps on devices with missing, uncalibrated, or faulty biometric hardware. App-process only; system_server is never touched.
This module operates locally at runtime. It performs state redirection only and does NOT collect, store, or transmit biometric templates, credentials, or private device data.
v2.2 — per-app control, inert by default
Also add system scope (inert; dev/USB spoof stays app-only)
